en: Play time is done. Where do the toys go?
The car goes in the box. Vroom, vroom, in!
The doll goes on the shelf. Up you go, doll!
The books go in the basket. Flap, flap, in!
All the toys are home. Clap, clap! What a tidy room.
id: Waktu bermain sudah selesai. Ke mana mainan pergi?
Mobil masuk ke kotak. Brum, brum, masuk!
Boneka naik ke rak. Ayo naik, boneka!
Buku masuk ke keranjang. Plak, plak, masuk!
Semua mainan sudah pulang. Prok, prok! Kamarnya rapi sekali.

readAloudNotes.en: Spread your hands and look around with a puzzled face.
readAloudNotes.id: Buka kedua tangan dan lihat sekeliling dengan wajah bingung.

readAloudNotes.en: Push a pretend car along your child's leg and say 'vroom'.
readAloudNotes.id: Dorong mobil pura-pura di kaki anak sambil berkata 'brum'.

readAloudNotes.en: Lift your hands high on 'up you go'.
Clap your palms softly like closing a book.
readAloudNotes.id: Tepukkan telapak tangan pelan seperti menutup buku.

readAloudNotes.en: Clap together and look around the room proudly.
readAloudNotes.id: Bertepuk tangan bersama dan lihat kamar dengan bangga.

sequenceCards.en: Card 1: toys scattered on a mat
Card 2: a toy car going into a box
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 2: mobil mainan masuk ke kotak

sequenceCards.en: Card 3: a doll sitting on a shelf
Card 4: books in a basket and a tidy room
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 4: buku di keranjang dan kamar yang rapi

objectives.en: Follows a simple tidy-up routine in a story.
objectives.id: Mengikuti rutinitas merapikan sederhana dalam cerita.

objectives.en: Matches each toy to its place.

meaning.en: a flat board on the wall or in a cupboard for keeping things
a woven box for carrying or keeping things
meaning.id: wadah anyaman untuk membawa atau menyimpan barang

prompt.en: What did we do when all the toys were home?
prompt.id: Apa yang kita lakukan saat semua mainan sudah pulang?

prompt.en: Why does each toy have its own home?
prompt.id: Mengapa setiap mainan punya rumahnya sendiri?

en: so we can find it easily next time
so the toys can eat dinner

connection.en: Putting things back in the same place each day builds independence and order.
connection.id: Mengembalikan barang ke tempat yang sama setiap hari melatih kemandirian dan keteraturan.

discussionPrompts.en: Where does your favourite toy live?
Which toy should we put away first?
discussionPrompts.id: Mainan mana yang kita rapikan duluan?

offlineActivity.en: Choose three large toys and give each a 'home': a box, a shelf and a basket. Say the story words as your child carries each toy home, then clap together.
offlineActivity.id: Pilih tiga mainan besar dan beri masing-masing 'rumah': kotak, rak, dan keranjang. Ucapkan kata-kata dalam cerita saat anak membawa setiap mainan pulang, lalu bertepuk tangan bersama.

safetyNotes.en: Use only large toys with no small parts that could be swallowed.
safetyNotes.id: Pakai hanya mainan besar tanpa bagian kecil yang bisa tertelan.

safetyNotes.en: Keep the shelf low and steady so nothing can fall on your child.
safetyNotes.id: Pastikan rak rendah dan kokoh supaya tidak ada yang jatuh menimpa anak.
